dialogue.origin: (本日はよろしくお願いいたします)
dialogue.content: (Thank you for coming in today.)

dialogue.origin: (トレーニングを開始してもよろしいでしょうか？)
dialogue.content: (May we begin the training?)

dialogue.origin: 大変失礼しました！おねがいできますか？
dialogue.content: I'm terribly sorry! Could you please proceed?

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫ですでは次のトークから始めます
dialogue.content: It's all right. Let's start with the next prompt.

dialogue.origin: お願い致します！
dialogue.content: Please do!

dialogue.origin: こんにちは本日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.content: Hello. What brings you in today?

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。ちょっと、姑との関係で悩んでいます
dialogue.content: Hello. I'm having some trouble with my mother-in-law.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・どんなところでお悩みなのですか？
dialogue.content: I see... What specific aspects are troubling you?

dialogue.origin: 夫の実家が近くにあるのですが、どうも甥と私の子供との扱いが違いすぎて…
dialogue.content: My husband's parents live nearby, but the way they treat my nephew and my own children is just so different...

dialogue.origin: それは困ってしまいますよね・・・どのようなところで違いが出ているのですか？
dialogue.content: That must be very difficult... In what ways is their treatment different?

dialogue.origin: 甥は、夫の妹の子供なんですが、うちの子よりだいぶ歳が上で、そちらが初孫なのでかわいいのはわかるのですが
dialogue.content: My nephew is my husband's sister's child. He's quite a bit older than my kids, and since he was the first grandchild, I understand that they dote on him, but...

dialogue.origin: はい・・・
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 習い事代から大学の学費までなんでも実家が出してあげてます。
dialogue.content: My in-laws pay for everything for him, from his extracurricular lessons to his university tuition.

dialogue.origin: え?!そうなんですか?!
dialogue.content: Oh, really?!

dialogue.origin: それで、実家の店を継がせる気もあったみたいなのですが
dialogue.content: And it seemed they also wanted him to take over the family business.

dialogue.origin: あ、妹が離婚してやはり実家の近くにいるので
dialogue.content: Oh, my sister-in-law is divorced and lives near her parents, so...

dialogue.origin: はい・・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 私は結婚が遅かったのでまだ子供2人、小学生なんですけど、こちらの面倒は全く見てもらえなくて。
dialogue.content: I got married later, so my two children are still in elementary school, but they don't help take care of them at all.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・あまりにも平等でないのですね・・・
dialogue.content: I see... That sounds incredibly unequal.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 嫌悪感のようなものを抱いてしまいますよね・・・とてもお辛いと思います
dialogue.content: It's understandable to feel a sense of aversion or resentment... I imagine this is very painful for you.

dialogue.origin: それでなくてもなんていうか、今上の子が支援学級にお世話になっているんです
dialogue.content: On top of that... how should I put it... my older child is currently in a special needs class.

dialogue.origin: そういう、子供に理解を持ってくれなくて
dialogue.content: They're just not understanding about things like that with my child.

dialogue.origin: 本当に顔を見るのも嫌になります
dialogue.content: Honestly, I get to the point where I don't even want to see her face.

dialogue.origin: なるほど・・・お姑さんのそのような態度だったり、理解のなさにも苛立ちを覚えてしまいますよね
dialogue.content: I understand... Your mother-in-law's attitude and lack of understanding must be so frustrating.

dialogue.origin: 嫌にもなると思います
dialogue.content: It's understandable you'd feel that way.

dialogue.origin: はい。都合の良い時だけ手伝って、とかいきなり電話してきます
dialogue.content: Yes. She only calls out of the blue when she needs a favor.

dialogue.origin: 都合のいいときというのは例えばどんなことがありましたか？
dialogue.content: When you say 'when she needs a favor,' what's an example of that?

dialogue.origin: ええと、この間はマスクが作りたいからミシンを貸してくれとか
dialogue.content: Um, well, the other day she asked to borrow my sewing machine because she wanted to make masks.

dialogue.origin: なるほど・・・そのようなことを急に電話でお願いされるのですね・・・
dialogue.content: I see... So she calls out of the blue with requests like that...

dialogue.origin: 都合がいいということは、それ以外の時は特に干渉してこないという感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So when you say it's only when it's convenient for her, does that mean she doesn't really get in touch at other times?

dialogue.origin: そうです。迷惑な顔をされるのでこちらからは遊びに行ったりしません。お店の仕事も、夫が同業者なので、何かと夫も有無を言わさずに手伝わされたりしてます
dialogue.content: That's right. We don't visit them because she makes it obvious we're a bother. As for the family business, since my husband is in the same trade, he often gets roped into helping without any say in the matter.

dialogue.origin: まだ小さい頃はおじいちゃんおばあちゃんに会わせてあげなくちゃ、と義理から連れて行ったりしていましたが
dialogue.content: When the children were little, I used to take them to visit out of a sense of duty, thinking they should see their grandparents, but...

dialogue.origin: はい・・・
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 本当ならせっかく実家が近いのでご飯食べさせてもらったり、と、甘えさせてもらえるかと思っていたのですけれど
dialogue.content: Since they live so nearby, I had honestly hoped we might be able to lean on them a bit—like having them make a meal for us once in a while—but...

dialogue.origin: 子供がじっとしていられないのもあって喜ばれていないのがわかってきてしまって
dialogue.content: But I came to realize they weren't happy to see us, partly because my kids have trouble sitting still.

dialogue.origin: 甥が、ちょうど今のうちの子くらいの歳で、かなり甘えさせてもらっているのを見ていたせいもあると思います。、
dialogue.content: I think it may also be because I saw how much they indulged my nephew when he was about the same age my kids are now.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・お姑さんはもう態度としても出てきてしまっているのですね・・・とても悲しいお気持ちになってしまいますね・・・
dialogue.content: I see... So your mother-in-law's feelings are clear from her attitude... That must make you feel very sad.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです…
dialogue.content: It does...

dialogue.origin: 旦那さんもそのことには気づいていらっしゃる感じですか？
dialogue.content: Does your husband notice this as well?

dialogue.origin: はい夫とは、率直に話をするので分かってくれてます。
dialogue.content: Yes, my husband and I speak openly, so he understands.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・なんだかそれが唯一の救いのような感じがしますね・・・
dialogue.content: I see... That sounds like the one silver lining in all of this.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうですね夫も、そういう扱いに慣れて育ったというか、お母さんを変だと思ってなかったみたいですけど
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right. Although, it seems my husband grew up accustomed to that kind of treatment, so he never thought his mother was strange, but...

dialogue.origin: 私の言うことに耳を傾けてくれてます
dialogue.content: But he listens to what I have to say.

dialogue.origin: それは心強いですよねとても素敵な方だと思います
dialogue.content: That must be reassuring. He sounds like a wonderful partner.

dialogue.origin: まぁ、はいもっと子供の面倒を見て欲しいとは思いますけど
dialogue.content: Well, yes... though I do wish he would help more with the children.

dialogue.origin: あ、子育てに関してはそれほど協力的ではないのですね・・・
dialogue.content: Oh, so he's not that helpful when it comes to child-rearing?

dialogue.origin: うーん、理解はしてくれてても、暮らしの中で家事とか分担してくれたりは全くないんです。
dialogue.content: Mmm, he understands, but he doesn't help with any of the household chores at all.

dialogue.origin: 仕事が忙しいので仕方ないと思ってます
dialogue.content: I tell myself it can't be helped because he's busy with work.

dialogue.origin: なるほど・・・ということは、話は聞いてくれるけど、特にお母さんに『子供は平等に接してほしい』というような要望は話してくれてないのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see... So he listens to you, but has he not specifically asked his mother to treat the children equally?

dialogue.origin: それは無いですね・・・
dialogue.content: No, he hasn't...

dialogue.origin: 夫は、仕事もからむのでわりと実家の言いなりなんです
dialogue.content: My husband is quite obedient to his parents, partly because of the business connection.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・それはそれで嫌な気分になってしまいますね・・・
dialogue.content: I see... That must be upsetting in its own way.

dialogue.origin: はい。本当に嫌な気分です。
dialogue.content: Yes. It's really upsetting.

dialogue.origin: あなたはお姑さんがなぜそこまで、理解がないのだと思いますか？
dialogue.content: Why do you think your mother-in-law is so lacking in understanding?

dialogue.origin: それは、散々考えましたけど、、、私が嫌いなのか理解力が足りないんじゃ無いですか
dialogue.content: I've thought about that a lot... I think it's either that she dislikes me or she simply lacks the ability to understand.

dialogue.origin: 結婚してからずっと嫁に来た格好でこの家に慣れよう、とがんばってきたつもりなんですが。。。
dialogue.content: Ever since we got married, I feel like I've tried my best to fit into this family as a daughter-in-law...

dialogue.origin: 大変だったと思います・・・甥っ子さんへの対応は手厚いようですが、あなたから見て、その対応は普通のものだと感じていますか？
dialogue.content: I'm sure that has been very difficult... You mentioned her treatment of your nephew is very generous. From your perspective, does that treatment seem normal?

dialogue.origin: いや、おかしいですよ。ここへきてお店も継ぎたく無いし、大学もやめると言い出してみんなが頭を抱えてます
dialogue.content: No, it's excessive. And now he's saying he doesn't want to take over the shop and wants to quit university, so everyone is at their wits' end.

dialogue.origin: 冷静に振り返ると、周りの大人に猫かわいがりされてきて、まともに大きくなれなかったのかもしれません
dialogue.content: Looking back calmly, maybe he couldn't mature properly because all the adults around him coddled him so much.

dialogue.origin: え?!そんなことになっているのですか?!あなたの子はそんな扱いをされているのに・・・
dialogue.content: What?! Is that what's happening?! And this is all while your children are being treated the way they are...

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。なんだか腹が立ちますよ。
dialogue.content: Exactly. It just makes me so angry.

dialogue.origin: それはイライラしてしまうますよね・・・そんな中冷静に物事をとらえてもいらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: That must be incredibly frustrating... And yet, you're able to look at the situation so calmly.

dialogue.origin: 甥っ子さんのお母さんとは関係はどうなのですか？
dialogue.content: What is your relationship like with your nephew's mother?

dialogue.origin: さあ、、私はこのところお母さんとも距離を取っているのでわからないですが、部屋を貸してあげているみたいです
dialogue.content: Well... I'm not sure. I've been keeping my distance from my mother-in-law lately, but it seems they're letting her stay in one of their rooms.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・お話を聞くと全体的にあちらのほうがひいき目になっている理不尽な状況のようすね・・・
dialogue.content: I see... From what you've told me, it sounds like an unreasonable situation where they are clearly favored.

dialogue.origin: 本当に大変だと思います・・・
dialogue.content: That must be so very difficult for you...

dialogue.origin: お金じゃなくても少し孫の世話を見てくれるとか、たまに何かしてくれてもいいのにってつい思ってしまいます。
dialogue.content: It's not about money, but I can't help but think they could at least help with the grandchildren sometimes, or do something for us once in a while.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね・・・同じ孫ですからね・・・
dialogue.content: That's right... They are all their grandchildren, after all...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたの理想としては、お姑さんとどのような関係を望んでいるのですか？
dialogue.content: Ideally, what kind of relationship would you like to have with your mother-in-law?

dialogue.origin: そうですね〜1番手のかかる時期は切り抜けたのでもう頼りにしなくてもいいんだろうけど
dialogue.content: Well... we've gotten through the most demanding period with the kids, so I suppose I don't need to rely on her anymore, but...

dialogue.origin: はい・・・
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: その甥の話を聞いたらなんだか、頭にきてしまって。
dialogue.content: When I hear about my nephew, I just get so angry.

dialogue.origin: 出来るだけ距離をおきたい、かな。
dialogue.content: I think I'd like to keep as much distance as possible.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね現状ですとあちらからの干渉としては、都合の良いときにだけ連絡が来るという感じでしたよね？
dialogue.content: I see. And as things stand, the only time they interfere is to contact you when it's convenient for them, is that right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お子さんはお姑さんに会いたいというような感じなのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Do your children ever say they want to see their grandmother?

dialogue.origin: それは特にありません
dialogue.content: Not particularly.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・ただ旦那さんは同業種ということもあり、どうしても関わらざるを得ないという感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see... But because your husband is in the same line of work, he has no choice but to be involved with them, is that right?

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: 確かにそれは悩んでしまいますよね・・・
dialogue.content: That’s certainly a difficult dilemma...

dialogue.origin: はい。私もたまに嫁として職場の掃除を手伝ったりもあります
dialogue.content: Yes. As the daughter-in-law, I sometimes help with things like cleaning their workplace, too.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・・甥っ子さんのお母さんもお店を手伝っているのですか？
dialogue.content: I see... Does your nephew's mother also help with the business?

dialogue.origin: それはないですね…プライベートな親としての関わりと、仕事を分けてもらえないか？と夫には言うのですがなかなか聞き入れてもらえないのか、言い出せないのか上手くいきません。
dialogue.content: No, she doesn't... I keep asking my husband if he can separate his parents' involvement as family from their involvement in the business, but it never goes well. I don't know if they won't listen, or if he just can't bring himself to say it.

dialogue.origin: それは困ってしまいますよね・・・家族のことを一番に考えてもらいたいのは当然だと思います・・・
dialogue.content: That must be very difficult... It's only natural to want him to put his own family first.

dialogue.origin: はい…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: (時間になってしまいましたね、テンポよく回答していただきありがとうございます)
dialogue.content: (It looks like our time is up. Thank you for your prompt responses.)

dialogue.origin: (時間に遅れてすみませんでした。)
dialogue.content: (I'm sorry for being late.)

dialogue.origin: (大丈夫です(^^)、ではこれで終了とします。ありがとうございました!!)
dialogue.content: (That's quite all right (^^). We'll end the session here. Thank you very much!)

dialogue.origin: (こちらこそ、ありがとうございました！)
dialogue.content: (Thank you as well!)

topic.sub: 姑との関係におけるひいきの問題
